title: File:The Pacific Ocean- Viewed from Space.png
desc: The Pacific Ocean: The view of Earth, taken from the Space Shuttle, is dominated by the Pacific Ocean. Above the water are clouds of water vapor and a volcanic ash plume, a reminder of the continuing geological activity of the planet's interior.
